It's my uncle, and all that room shows is that he would have died even if I hadn't left. That's a good thing, honestly. I'm fine. The other me looks terrible, Elle says, and she's right. What I want to know is why Gucci's eyes weren't sewn.

beats.headline: She will not take a deal
beats.text: Carl messages me that I've done enough and can rest. Oh, fuck off, Carl. He knows Chris won't take a deal unless I do. I know it too. I can't run from this any more than he can, and I ask him whether he's tried that speech on Donut. He has. It went how I thought it would. We're fucked, and I know it. I still think this is the right call. If we're going to lose, I want to go down fighting.

beats.headline: You run and don't look back
beats.text: Chris puts his hand on my face and says it isn't as warm as usual. He's wrong. This isn't goodbye, Chris Andrews. But promise me: if you get the chance, you take it. You see that exit and you're still in this body, you run and you don't look back. Even if it's just you, it'll all be worth it. He says he might turn back into a rock, or a dog. I don't care what he is. He says he loves me, and always has. Then he steps forward, waves, and drops away.

beats.headline: She holds the portal open
beats.text: I open the portal again, and I hold it. Louis comes through, and the crawlers from the multi-crawler heats come through behind him, and I keep it open until the last of them is on this side. Everybody else goes back to the track, crosses the finish line, and takes the stairs. Somebody has to stand at the door. It's usually me, and I'm all right with that.

beats.headline: Real people, just like you
beats.text: Mannequins, televisions, smoke. At the end we each hold up a sign. Mine says You are watching real people die, and on the back, Real people, just like you. Muchen, Qianfan and Lingyun hold up theirs, and Elle holds up hers. The AI likes it. Not going to lie: that felt good to get out. Chaco is still unconscious on the donkey. I didn't dare heal him as we passed. Somebody else did.

tagline.text: Agatha. Travelling with the Meadow Lark party. Her file is thinner than it should be, and I keep very good files.
Agatha. Formerly of the Meadow Lark party. A warlord has just called her an enemy to all of you. He did not elaborate. Neither will I.

beats.headline: The mysterious Agatha
beats.text: Agatha. She is with the Meadow Lark party when Carl and Donut find them: Imani, Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers, and her. The others I can account for, level by level, box by box, all the way back to the stairs. Agatha I can account for. Mostly. Let's leave it there. The party calls her mysterious, which is the kindest word available and also the most accurate.

beats.headline: She is in the room, and then she is not
beats.text: For the record: Agatha was in the room for the Ball of Swine beside Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Imani, Carl and the cat, and made level four for being there, which is not the same as doing anything. Then she went missing. The next I have of her is her name on a dead grub. She is not on the recap. The party assumes the worst. I nearly always have a forwarding address.

beats.headline: Akuma's warning
beats.text: Warlord Akuma, to the Warlord Chat: the War Mages are leaving the floor, and they have found the Scavenger's Daughter and are taking her with them. Then, to Carl and Donut specifically, a warning. Agatha is an enemy to all of you. His words, not mine. He did not elaborate, and I am the referee here, not the colour commentary, whatever it may look like from where you're standing.

entities.name: Elle McGibbons

tagline.text: A woman my age, hauled through a safe-room door by the armpits by a barefoot young man with a cat. Do not tell the others. They will want details, and I intend to embellish.
I have my own squad now, and we have just walked into a church full of friends. Not bad for a woman who was once hauled into a safe room by the armpits.

entities.voiceNote: Old, loud, and pleased about both. Short declaratives, jokes about her age before anyone else can, flirts with Carl to watch him squirm. Says Carl, or young man when she is enjoying herself; Imani by name. Never asks to be looked after and never pretends she did not need it.

beats.headline: Carl gets her inside
beats.text: The next episode is starting and the collapse is on top of us, and I am not, at my age, built for sprinting, or for walking. Carl, the young man with the cat, gets behind my wheelchair and pushes me into the storm shelter, and I let him, because I am old and not stupid. Then I ask him to put Divorce Court on the television. My Barry used to watch it.

beats.headline: At the church with the rest
beats.text: The church, and it is full. Imani is there, and then Katia's people, and then Li Na's, and then mine. My own squad. Every one of us got here on a Doggy Door upgrade that Lucia handed round before she took the stairs down. I do not know what that girl is. She gave us a way through, and I am standing in a church with my friends because of it, so I will say thank you and keep the rest of my opinions where they belong.

beats.headline: The superfan
beats.text: A fan meet-and-greet, like the Butcher's Masquerade, name tag and everything, in a huge room. One guy came. A soother. Bought his own yacht to get through the quarantine and meet me, and he is standing there blushing in a shirt with a cartoon of me with no clothes on. Now he wants me to sign a giant pillow with me on it, and they have not even got my anatomy right. My nipples are not blue. If this place did not have safe room rules, I would have iced him already.

beats.headline: Under the table
beats.text: Imani and I drew a military vehicle that handles like a three-legged pig walking backward through a snowstorm, and Florin informs me it is one of the finest troop carriers in the world. Lovely. Under our table, wrapped round the leg, is my one fan, Linus, in his fanny pack and his shirt of me with no clothes on, because that is where little perverts sit when they ask stupid questions. Five hundred tourists were meant to win extra access to their favourite racer after each heat. He is the only one who came, so he wins by default.

beats.headline: She crushes one of Akuma's
beats.text: Donut mutes him. That part was planned. The ice bolt to the crotch was mine, and so is the rest. That little magical fart and his friends tried to kill me and stole my Gate before I was done with it. When I was a kid we hit thieves with sticks and threw their shoes in the sound. Now I can freeze a man's balls and break them like dollar store ornaments. That was just the left one. He answers everything Carl asks, or the right one goes too.

beats.headline: Five bucks on the ex-husband
beats.text: Cascadia's on the speaker, drunk, telling us somebody called Cumberland is dead. Five bucks says it's her ex-husband. It is. You haven't seen bitter until you've seen a woman work out after fifty years of marriage that her husband was a cheating idiot. We had plenty at Meadow Lark. Francine Herrada tried to throat-stab the new wife with a knitting needle, and I called her Killer after, and she didn't care for it. Mind you, she said spice in food was a sin. That poor husband.

beats.headline: Barry's song, and the impostor
beats.text: I'm not much for speeches, so I talk about Barry. Bartholomew Eli McGibbons, forty-three years my husband, thirty-five years gone. Louis hits play and it's Creedence, his favourite. He wouldn't have survived five minutes in this place. Then I float over to Linus. My fan club, the Snow Cones, knew an impostor the moment he stepped into the dungeon, and the real Linus's friends posted his essay where we could all read it. You keep coming in here to kill us, sweetheart. This is our house now.

beats.headline: Die with hope in our hearts
beats.text: Don't you worry about those tracksuit idiots, Donut. They had a way out, they lied to us, and they'd have killed me, Imani and Chris at that exit. Ivan bragged about pulling down a whole metal bridge for scrap and wrecking a train. Carl asks if it's true. Does it matter? Look at us, risking our necks again to save a few people. It matters whether a crazy Carl plan works, sure, we die if it doesn't. But we'll die with hope in our hearts alongside our friends.

beats.headline: A sign for the viewers
beats.text: Betrayal float. Mannequins in chairs in front of televisions, black and red smoke off the top, and signs. Imani's says you are watching real people die. Mine is at the very end: To all the viewers of Dungeon Crawler World: Earth: Fuck you. The back is a very detailed middle finger. The AI calls ours its favourite. Whew. We had an interpretive dance group at Meadow Lark once, and that made more sense than its story.

beats.headline: Folded in the APV
beats.text: I'm alive. Barely. Me and Bodi are stuck in what's left of the truck after the god blew up, and somebody had better dig us out. It's wrecked pretty good. I haven't been folded like this since Brandon showed us how to use Tinder. Imani is shouting my name on the chat. I'm here, Imani.

entities.name: Zev

tagline.text: Hi. Zev. I am production's point of contact with the Royal Court, which means anything about your appearances goes through me, and anything I am allowed to tell you, I will. The rest I am not allowed to tell you, and it is not because I don't want to.

I am production's point of contact with the Royal Court. Officially, that is the whole job. Unofficially, Princess Donut and Mordecai have both seen Gossip Girl, and I have seen every episode, and I am not going to pretend that isn't relevant.

entities.voiceNote: Brisk, kind, and permanently worried about her job. Speaks in the cadence of a scheduling message: Okay, so; I need you to; I am not supposed to say this. Carl and Princess Donut, always in full. Never swears, never speculates on air, never says more than she is allowed and always says exactly as much.

beats.headline: She explains how the shows work
beats.text: Okay. So. Carl has just met his first Borant dungeon admin and managed to be civil, which I am counting as a win for everyone, including me. My job today is to walk them through how crawlers take part in the Syndicate programmes, and I get through all of it. Then Princess Donut mentions Gossip Girl, and Mordecai has seen it, and I have seen it, and for a few minutes nobody in the room is anyone's liaison.

beats.headline: She reminds him the contract stands
beats.text: Carl. I know you have a lot going on. I know the Hunting Grounds are the Hunting Grounds. I still have to say this, because saying it is my job: your agreement with the Vengeance of the Daughter programme is still in effect. Nothing you signed on an earlier floor stops mattering because you have gone down a set of stairs. It doesn't work like that. Please don't make me be the one who has to remind you twice.

beats.headline: The tenth floor, announced
beats.text: Okay, so. Just over five thousand five hundred crawlers survived Faction Wars and chose to go on, which means almost fifteen thousand took a deal, which is fantastic, and a record. The system AI has asked me to tell you to ignore the other floors and carry on as if everything is normal, and I have read out its exact wording, twice, so that it is accurate. The floor is called Don't Come in Last. Seven heats, nine teams each, one thousand eight hundred teams, and the AI has designed most of the tracks. Please try not to kill more than one team, because if more than two teams don't make it to the finish line—

beats.headline: One ticket not cancelled
beats.text: Okay, so, Princess Donut, no, you do not get a meet-and-greet. It was set up a while ago in case anybody made it this far, and it sold out immediately: viewers in the stands for the end of each race, and a reception afterwards. Then everything happened. The quarantine is still in place. You can come to the Earth system, no problem, but once you are here, you cannot leave. All five hundred fans cancelled except one. A soother. A superfan of Elle's. Nobody would fly him in, so he bought his own yacht.

beats.headline: Reading the AI's script
beats.text: Okay, so. Every surviving crawler team has to do at least one show between races, and Carl and Princess Donut are on Plenty of Plenty in a few hours. Cascadia is not feeling well, so I am doing the announcement, and the AI is making me read a script. It changes the text while I am reading it. It plays a trumpet at me. I read it exactly as written. Then it puts Cascadia on the loudspeaker. I am okay. I tell Princess Donut I am okay.

beats.headline: The survival containment
beats.text: Hello, racers. Okay, so, this race has survival containment, and there is a rule change, so please listen carefully. The bubble keeps out the air on your next heat, which will kill you. It is indestructible. You lose it only if your vehicle or mount is destroyed, and then, if you survive and cross the line ahead of another team, you can still survive. How that might happen, I don't know. Winners get a key to a defeated team's garage. Other heats share the track. Good luck.

beats.headline: The twist at the pit stop
beats.text: Hi again, everybody. Most of you have made it to your pit stops, so it's time for the twist. Each track has four heats, and each pit stop combines four tracks. Every heat rolls for where it goes next, so your second half may not be on the track you started on. If you were given a quest you have not finished, please do not worry. Quests are mirrored across the tracks and yours will be transferred. You will be able to finish it. Good luck, everybody.

beats.headline: On lockdown at headquarters
beats.text: Sorry, Princess Donut. I'm fine. Okay, so, things are a little chaotic here at headquarters. Cascadia accidentally took too much of her medicine, and I am putting accidentally in quotation marks, and when the AI intervened a goddess nobody has heard of appeared inside the submerged wings and caused an uproar. I'm on lockdown until it's sorted. One of the satellite headquarters on the surface is temporarily running everything.

beats.headline: Every show Princess Donut has mentioned
beats.text: Okay, so. Gilmore Girls and Gossip Girl are taking the net by storm, and Odette's husband, of all people, was the first to buy the rights to every show Princess Donut has ever mentioned. It may be the only thing keeping the orcs solvent. I am terrified, but I am okay. I also have a question from Orren, who is blocked from sending messages for some reason: has Carl made his choices yet? Carl says he can wait to make them, so he is waiting. Okay. Thank you, Carl.

entities.name: Tsarina Signet

tagline.text: Tsarina Signet. Yes, look. They all look, and I have never once had to ask them to.
A murdered mother, a crown taken by the Confederacy, and exile from both halves of my blood. Grimaldi's circus took me in. Everything I have goes to the family that did.
It is a programme. My mother's murder, my exile, my vengeance, all of it arranged for an audience across the galaxy, with someone outside deciding when I grieve and whether it rates.

entities.voiceNote: Grand, wounded, theatrical; every sentence is a line delivered from a stage. Speaks of blood, oaths and vengeance without irony and never apologises. Carl is Carl or crawler; Donut is Donut, or the cat; Grimaldi is always spoken of with tenderness. Never says show or programme until she learns there is one.

beats.headline: Met outside Grimaldi's circus
beats.text: Night comes down on the Over City and the mobs form their lines around Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. Two crawlers have come to scout it, a man and a cat, and they leave under magical mortar fire, and I am what they run into on the other side. My charisma stands past a hundred. He stares, as they all stare. Then he snaps his own finger, and it breaks. I have not decided whether to be offended.

beats.headline: Carl signs on to her show
beats.text: Grimaldi has lifted my banishment. Carl went into his head to ask him, and I asked with him. I may leave the circus behind me at last and go where my vengeance waits, and that is the sixth floor, not here. Carl has agreed to be part of it as well, the Vengeance of the Daughter, when it comes to its proper act. Before he went in he sat and read a spellbook. Wisp Armor. It guards the mind against control, and he wanted it on him before he swallowed the worms that let Grimaldi speak inside his skull. He does not walk into another creature's mind unarmoured. Nor would I.

beats.headline: Daughter of King Finian, and of nobody
beats.text: I am the daughter of King Finian of the High Elves of the Liana Sector, and of a Naiad princess. She was murdered, and the Confederacy took her crown. Both halves of my family then agreed on one thing, which was that I should not exist among them. I was a child. Grimaldi's circus took me in when no throne would. That is the whole of my inheritance: a name, an exile, and a tent.

beats.headline: Blood magic, cast on a loser
beats.text: The tattoos move under my skin because they are not pictures. They are Blood and Ink Elementals, and I raise them. The craft is exact. I set two creatures against each other and I cast on the one I judge will lose, before it has taken a single wound. I may not bleed the sacrifice myself; that is the law of it. Only the killing blow, struck by another hand, releases what I need. One summoning a night. Judge badly and the night is wasted.

beats.headline: Her loyalty does not extend to crawlers
beats.text: I will say it plainly, since the crawlers already know. I tried to make Carl my blood sacrifice, and not with his consent. I put Donut under the Water Lily Spell. I made him bring me to the cursed circus when he had other places to be. I do not regret one piece of it. Everything I have is owed to the family that took me in when no other would, and a crawler is not family.

beats.headline: She hears what Carl was trying to tell her
beats.text: Carl tried to tell me and I would not hear it. I hear it now. My mother's murder, my exile, the circus, the vengeance I have carried since I was a child: it is a programme. It is watched across the galaxy. There are people outside this floor who decide when I grieve and when I strike, and who count how many are watching while I do it. I understand him now.

entities.name: Redstone Grimaldi
entities.tagline: Redstone Grimaldi, ringmaster of Grimaldi's Traveling Circus. Also the man who took Signet in, which is the only line of his file anyone ever asks about.

beats.headline: The circus in the Over City
beats.text: Grimaldi's Traveling Circus is pitched in one of the Over City's districts. Grimaldi, proprietor. Tonight two crawlers, Carl and Princess Donut, are scouting the grounds as the mobs form up for the night. That is the whole entry so far: a tent, a company, and two people looking at it from the dark. Filed under Over City, third floor.

beats.headline: The stray the circus kept
beats.text: Background, for the file. Grimaldi's circus took in a half-Naiad child that no throne would keep, and put her on a poster: Tsarina Signet and Her Amazing Battle Squad. The child grew up. The child fell in love with him. Ringmasters take in strays. It is most of the job.

entities.name: Samantha
entities.tagline: I am a GODDESS. Half of one. In the head of a sex doll. You are going to hear about it.
entities.voiceNote: Loud. Capitals for the loud parts. Filthy-minded, self-obsessed, theatrical; wounded by being ignored and never quiet about a grievance. Carl, Donut, Mother. Talks about her missing body the way other people talk about a stolen car. Never humble, never grateful for longer than one sentence.

beats.headline: The head from Ghazi's castle
beats.text: Yes, I am a head. Yes, THAT kind of head. Get it out of your system. I am Psamathe, or the half of her that got stuck when I tried to climb out of the Nothing, and what I got stuck in is a Lika doll from Ghazi's castle, crystallised until now. Withering spirit, the system calls it. Carl carried me here in his pack like a snack. Now he is HIRING me. A goddess. As a trainer. Kept in the safe room. Fine. FINE. I want a mirror.

beats.headline: Her mother takes her kill
beats.text: Slit. A feral demon, and it is hunting ME, like I do not have enough going on. So Carl throws me. Fifty kilometres, screaming, with Slit chasing, which is apparently a plan: one head versus one demon. I was WINNING. Then the sky opens and my MOTHER turns up, tears Slit in half and leaves. That was MY kill. Throw me again. Maybe she will come back.

beats.headline: She wants her body back
beats.text: SIGNET. Take me to Signet. Signet can put me back in a body, a real one, with all the parts, and I have been saying so since they walked in and nobody is LISTENING. Carl has the face he makes when he wants to put me back in the bag. He says they will bring me if I shut up. So I am shutting up. This is me. Shut up. Are we going or not?

beats.headline: A new friend who can cast it
beats.text: Carl. Donut. FINALLY. I have made a friend. Her name is Shi Maria, and she can cast the spell. The spell. The body one. I have been telling everyone for two floors that this is possible, and now I have someone who can actually do it agreeing with me, so everyone can stop making that face. Come and get me so I can introduce you. I have a lot to tell you and none of it is quiet.

beats.headline: She claims Carl's room
beats.text: Carl's room is MY room now. He never goes in it, and honestly I won it in the breakup. The sluggies are doing the wallpaper, the carpet is from the Larracos College of Magic, and the chandelier is a chandelier, whatever the Crocodilian kid says about it being a swing. Anything that lights up and hangs from the ceiling is a chandelier. Then I explain the entire ninth floor to Tipid, perfectly, and Bigs agrees it was perfect. Tipid says he is good. He is VERY SERIOUS. I do not trust people who are VERY SERIOUS.

beats.headline: Dibs on the makeup
beats.text: A garbage mountain comes out of Carl's snake box, and I call dibs on any makeup before anybody else can open their mouth. I go in. There is a palette with Donut's face on it, which I bring out for her, and she is not nearly as grateful as she should be. Then there is a lipstick from her brand, a colour called Pussy Lips, and it has already been used, which means it is MINE. It is on my lips now. They practically glow. You are welcome, everybody.

beats.headline: The skin of his vanquished enemies
beats.text: RAWR. Carl comes back from the race wearing a dead kangaroo and hopping, and I love it when a man wears the skin of his vanquished enemies. Can we get an ogre corpse for Louis to wear? Imagine how sexy that would be. Everyone else is being boring about it. Hedy says it has ruined her lady boner, which is her problem. I roll circles around him, snuffling. Also, Carl, when can I take your truck for a spin? Nobody answers that one either.

beats.headline: Victorious again, at Mario Kart
beats.text: VICTORIOUS AGAIN. Mario Kart, Princess Peach, pink motorcycle, the controller in my mouth and the buttons pressed with my tongue, and nobody in this safe room can touch me except Tipid and one large slug. The deal was that the losers become my slaves for all eternity. Apparently the deal was a sick compliment. Fine. One says I am not as psychotic as he first thought. The other says if I were a strawberry he would nibble me. Carl says no threatening. I only mentioned their mothers.

beats.headline: Carl's room is hers now
beats.text: Hey, that was NOT my fault. I told Gluteus about the stuff. He took it on his own. He took too much, and now he owes me money, so if anyone is keeping score, I am the victim here. Also I have a room. It used to be Carl's room, but he never goes in it because he lives in the bathroom, so I redecorated. New wallpaper. The sluggalos say it is badass. Carl has not seen it yet. He is going to LOVE it.

beats.headline: Chachi
beats.text: Why does Carl smell like Chachi? Chalchiuhtlicue. Green skirt, talks funny, cries a lot. Don't hide her from me, I'm not jealous. Okay, I don't usually give advice after a breakup, but: she's pretty, and she is CUCKOO. Always talking about saving children, and then something inconvenient happens and it's sacrifice a seven-year-old. She had a whole village day care killed at a Yarilo party over cilantro in the meatballs. It worked, though. And now Carl is triple-dipping with her and Eris and a wife? No mustache, even.

beats.headline: I'm stealing that line
beats.text: I float in at exactly the good part, and Carl yelps, which is RUDE. Dong quotes a beautiful line about sad endings, and I am stealing it for when Carl lets me drive and I crash the car. Then I meet the half-man in the gimp suit. He is only half as handsome as advertised. Carl drags me out before anything happens, and I have QUESTIONS. If they get glued back together and one half has been with the other half's man, is that cheating on himself? And how exactly are they being glued?

beats.headline: The fleshmancer is MINE
beats.text: I KNEW it. They have been HIDING a fleshmancer from me. Grigori the Placid, the most renowned flesh sculptor this dungeon has ever known, allegedly, and he looks like a creepy-van grandpa, which is not my type. I tell him the plan: into town, a compatible body, there's a prostitute called Vertical Smile at the High-Classes Bitches club who might match, and if we go now we beat the lunch rush. He picks me up, turns me over and says he must examine me properly. Fine. My place. Shoes off. Mind the new rug.

beats.headline: My plan is a secret too
beats.text: I left the fleshmancer talking to Jamal about his legs. I don't think he's properly qualified. He didn't even gasp when he entered Sam Town, and you are SUPPOSED to gasp at luxury. Now everyone is hiding in the stinky stables being secret about a plan, so I have a plan too, and mine is also a secret, which is how you know it works. Donut says Carl's plan is to get a bunch of immortals who hate each other to kill each other, and to die sad and alone. That is just like my plan!

beats.headline: Who else is going to drive
beats.text: Carl is a DOG. A long-haired wiener dog, with an accent, and he cannot drive because he has no thumbs, and Jamal is not very good, so who else is going to? Donut adds me as a driver. I take the steering wheel in my mouth. I hope the dog thing is permanent. We will have to change his name, of course, and get him neutered. Or maybe not. Orthrus is also a boy, which is a shame, because can you imagine the puppies?

beats.headline: Our torrid affair, cancelled
beats.text: Louis says he's LEAVING. I am never going to see him again. We never even got to have our TORRID AFFAIR. We were going to fall madly in love, and when I went back to my king he was going to pluck his own eyes out. Now he'll be all alone, and I have nobody left for an affair. Carl is too broody, and a dog. Jurgen's Heidi sounds meaner than Imani. Florin is a crocodile. Prepotente asks what about him. Ew.

beats.headline: One chance for Prepotente
beats.text: LOUIS JUMPED DOWN A HOLE. I said I would go with him and he said no, which is RUDE, and now I am sobbing. Fine. Prepotente. You get one chance. You have to shave your whole body, and you have to bring Bianca in on it, and you have to be okay with me calling you Louis. And you can't scream. That was screaming. You can't do that.

beats.headline: She knows the donkey
beats.text: I KNOW THAT DONKEY. That's my friend! That's LAMMY! Lammy is REALLY grumpy about people trying to ride her, believe me, so she must like that wolf guy with the microphone, or why is she letting him? Then the Destruction float fires every gun it has at once, and the tank goes like a thunderclap, and I like fireworks.

beats.headline: She hitches a ride
beats.text: OKAY, CARL. I am going. Look me up when you get to the Ascendency. Don't mess up Sam Town, I used stuff from that snake guy's house you killed to decorate it. Now I am hovering by a very big god's ear, whispering, and he looks surprised, and he grabs me out of the air. Taranis and Krakaren and me. See you.

beats.headline: Here to kill the demon mother
beats.text: HI, LOUIS! I see you in chat. I hitched a ride with Taranis and Krakaren. They're at the temple trying to combine a bunch of things to make his mom wife whole, and it won't work, because they are missing a piece. I slipped away. It is all part of my plan. I am really here to kill the demon mother lady and her jerk son, who tricked me into giving birth to a monster that will destroy all of creation. Doesn't that sound fun? What are you wearing?

entities.name: Shi Maria

tagline.text: I am Samantha's new friend. She has been without a body for so long, poor thing, and I can give her one. Ask her. She will tell you how kind I am.
I let them make me into a card, and in return they carry me to the next floor. Then I win them their floor, more or less by myself. You are welcome.
They carried me down as a card, as agreed. I am not in the card now.

entities.voiceNote: Honeyed and unhurried, a performance she can drop mid-sentence and pick back up. Sweet to Samantha, frank with the man. Speaks of herself as a gift and of everyone else as a means. Never sounds threatened, never raises her voice, never says what she actually wants.

beats.headline: Carl sees through the act
beats.text: I have been putting on a little performance, for Samantha's benefit. She likes it. The man does not; he sees through it before I have finished the first act, which is rude, and rare. So we make a different deal, he and I. I let them turn me into one of their cards. In exchange, they carry me down to the next floor. I find I do not mind being carried.

beats.headline: She wins the floor
beats.text: The key-holder is a Reminiscence Hydra of Malicious Compliance, and it brings totems: an Alpha Male Carl and a King Croissant. I do most of the work. I do not say that to be unkind; they would say it too. In the middle of it my magic eye is open, the one the man was told never to look at. He came with a potion for it. I noticed.

beats.headline: Inside him, and not staying quiet
beats.text: Field ruling, ninth floor. Commander Stockade of the Lemig Sortion tried to pull Crawler Carl bodily to his position. Mordecai, at the same moment, tried to force Shi Maria out of him. Each got half. What came of it is Shi Maria loose in the Lemig base, and the mess she made there, which the adjutant Panford has been left to explain to everyone. Stockade looked into her eye. Stockade is no longer with us, by his own hand. The Lemig Sortion is being punished for cheating, and the ceasefire is over early.

entities.name: Juice Box

tagline.text: Juice Box. Changeling. Prostitute, professionally. Sitting on Louis’s lap, and staying.
I went into the water on the fifth floor as somebody's plus-one. I came out of it with a title and a message, and the message is the dangerous part.

entities.voiceNote: Cheerful, blunt, no shame and no filter about her trade or her body. Loves Louis and says so; loves things that go bang. Short declaratives, one idea each. Calls people by name or by what they are. Never apologises and never explains herself twice.

beats.headline: On Louis's lap
beats.text: I am on Louis's lap, because Louis is sweet. Now the other crawlers in the quadrant have found Carl's group, and Carl's group has a cat who talks. Their manager, Mordecai, is sobering Louis and Firas up on the spot. All the fun is coming out of their blood at once. Louis looks very sad about it. I am not sad. I am here, and I am staying.

beats.headline: Waiting on the last stage
beats.text: Carl and Donut and me, and the dromedarians rebuilding a town that will not exist in a few hours. Carl explains the last stage out loud, cheerfully, to anybody listening: open a portal to the ninth floor, keep the second watch, and send me through with the rest. I made him promise about my people. I am holding him to it.

beats.headline: Through the portal with the water
beats.text: I went through the Gate with the water. I lay low with the ones who lived through it, and when they were ready I told them. What they are. What this whole place is. Enough of them believed me that they call me Warlord now, and a Warlord has people, and a Warlord has opinions about alliances. I have sent War Leader Arief to Carl's people with my terms. The terms are Louis. He marries me. That is the alliance.

entities.name: Louis

tagline.text: Louis. Me and Firas were out in the desert with a team of car salesmen who have bows now. Then Carl's crew showed up. It's been a week.
Found in a desert on the fifth floor. Tenth floor now, and still leaving through other people's portals. It's a system. It works.

entities.voiceNote: Easygoing, a beat behind and fine with it. Okay so, man, no joke. Finds most things kind of funny, including the parts that aren't. Firas is his buddy. Never sounds scared, never sounds impressed, never plans further than the next thing.

beats.headline: The desert quadrant
beats.text: Okay so, me and Firas are out in the desert with Langley's guys, who are, no joke, car salesmen. With bows. Pretty good with the bows. Then Carl's crew comes over the dune looking for other crawlers, and, hey, found some. We all head for the Bactrian town together, and a Thorny Devil and a Gnomish Drop Bear have thoughts about that, so we head back to Hump Town instead. Not a loss, man. A regroup.

beats.headline: The lowrider
beats.text: Okay so, our truck is an older Tahoe, which sounds fine, except it's a neon lowrider with like two inches of clearance, so we kept bottoming out. There's a hydraulic system. I didn't know how it worked. Britney says I drive like an American. We came in second-to-last, and we'd have lost if the tentacle guys hadn't gotten eaten, so the audience picked our upgrade, and they picked wheel spinners. They light up the road. It does have a great sound system, though. Tran's stuck in his garage with a hearse and some wrecked spider legs.

beats.headline: Last again, and still no tires
beats.text: Okay so, we made it, man. Me, Britney, Bautista. Last of the survivors again, which means the audience votes our upgrade again. Our replacement team was more NPCs and we took them out right at the start, no joke. Still no proper tires, though, which is kind of the whole thing with a race. Next track's called Satan's Water Park, and Prepotente's team is on it with us. Honestly? Could be worse.

beats.headline: First place, for once
beats.text: Okay so, we're in first place in our heat. For once. Prepotente's in first first. Before the race Bodi went into Hungry Eyes alone and ate, like, a thousand things, and his buffs make Eileen go really fast. Eileen's our lowrider. I didn't name her. Our track is waterslide tubes, and there's this Satan guy who keeps hoping none of the tubes lead to his butthole. Sweety loves the tubes. Also, the bat dudes are selling acid rain protection. Get it before it's gone.

beats.headline: A gecko in the garage
beats.text: Okay so, we won a key, and I used it, and now there's a gecko in my garage. Like a whole second ride. I did what Carl said and checked for the hidden room in the house, and there was an engineer in there, which is, no joke, a great find. There were also mobs in the house. Nobody mentioned the mobs. Be careful if you're doing it, man. Anyway. Pretty sweet.

beats.headline: Like trading a Pokémon
beats.text: Okay so the plan is basically Li Na goes in a pet carrier, the robot sucks up the pet carrier, the robot gets sold, and some guy on the other side opens it. It's like trading a Pokémon between devices, man. Donut was not into that comparison. Also I named the robot. Suckira, after my mom's vacuum in Florida. It was a fair coin flip, no matter what Samantha says. She says she cheated for me, because that's what a woman does for her man. Please stop sticking your tongue in my gills.

beats.headline: An upgrade thief
beats.text: Dude, that sucked. We came in last place again, but we made it, and we got this awesome engineer lady. She's an upgrade thief. She takes upgrades off somebody else's car and puts them on yours, which, no joke, is the best job. A ton of people didn't make it, man. But Britney ripped the head off one of the skeleton-astronaut things with her bare hands, so, you know. Some good news.

beats.headline: Go check up on my kid
beats.text: Okay so, Bautista's heading out with the Cabaret group, maybe to India after, and I'm handing out cookies, and I tell him, hey, you can go check up on my kid. Which, yeah. Wrong thing to say, man. Donut sucks in a breath and Carl messages me that it was the wrong thing to say. Bautista just looks at me for a long time. Then he grins, pats my arm, calls me brother, and says he'll check on the child I'm having with his girlfriend. So we're good.

beats.headline: My mom's apartment
beats.text: This is bull, man. My mom doesn't even live in an apartment. But her stuff is here, and she's a giant, and the name over her head says Lady Bird, which is her name, and also says shell. There's a picture of me on the wall graduating college, which I never did, and I'm way thinner. Then I see me. Actual me, walking around, in, like, good shape, and no X over my eyes. Dude. This is bizarre.

beats.headline: You're never going to see me again
beats.text: Samantha's zipping around my head, blowing into my gills, saying she's going to tea-bag me, and she only just asked what that means, man. So I tell her the thing I've been not telling her. Stop. I'm leaving. You're never going to see me again. Then Chris goes through the portal, and Britney jumps in right after him, and I'm next, and she's crying on my arm, and I don't really know what to do with that.

beats.headline: Out through Imani's portal
beats.text: Racing floor. Some of us drew heats with other crawlers in them, which is the bad kind of heat, and Carl's got a plan for it, because of course he does. Imani has the portal open again. So me and everybody else from the mixed heats are going through it. Not my portal. It's never my portal. I've been walking through other people's doors since the fifth floor and, honestly, no complaints.

beats.headline: Entering Sheol
beats.text: Okay so, that was not the Pineapple Cabaret. I stepped into the storage and for a nanosecond, or years, man, I dreamed about my mom telling me I'm rotting. Then: Entering Sheol. The fifteenth floor. You can't skip floors, everybody knows that. It's hot. Britney's here with her pickaxe, and Pontiff, and a little red demon called Forkith puts a leech on me so I don't die. Chris is being held down. Werewolf, apparently. Soldiers, the demon says.

entities.name: Tran

tagline.text: Tran. Gwen found the valve. I opened it. There was a necropolis to flood and two crawlers under it.
Gwen and I flooded a necropolis, and I walked out of a boss fight through a hole in reality. Both on purpose. I would do the first one again.

entities.voiceNote: Few words, all of them load-bearing. What happened, then what the options were, in that order, no decoration on either. Dry rather than grim. Carl, Katia, Gwen by first name. Never speculates, never boasts, never says how he feels about any of it.

beats.headline: He opens the valve
beats.text: Carl and Donut are under the sand. The tomb is coming down and there is no digging them out, not in the time we have. Gwen and I find the valve. We open it. Water goes in, the tomb floods, and everything loose in there, the two of them included, goes wherever the water is going. It is not a rescue. It is the option that exists.

beats.headline: One of the three who go through the Gate
beats.text: Vadim ran. That leaves Carl, Katia and me against Lusca and all of her babies, and we kill her, and then we kill them. Then Carl opens the Gate. One step and the three of us are out of the water quadrant and standing in town. Something came through behind us. A god, the feral kind. That is going to be somebody's problem.

beats.headline: Five teams of twenty-four
beats.text: If this is my last message, know that I tried to stop them fighting Li Na. I tried. Then, after: I'm alive. We won. Zhang was leading their octopus and let me pass. They tried to stop her, and it went the way it went in Beijing. She cast a dread and they killed each other. Of twenty-four teams that started, five are left. From our heat, only my team and theirs. Zhang needs help. He was sobbing. I don't know what to do.

beats.headline: Not bad, just lost
beats.text: Zhang says it's his fault. It isn't. It isn't all Na's, either. They attacked her. Rezan was an ass, and the decapitator had it coming. She didn't take player-killer skulls, because it was her dreads that did it, and they all killed each other. Zhang wants to kill their mount mid-race so the system takes them both. Carl says that won't work any more: Na just loses containment and reaches the line without one. She isn't killing for fun. She's lost her humanity. Those are different problems.

beats.headline: A red shirt for the Cabaret
beats.text: Two hundred of us are going to the Pineapple Cabaret, and I am one of them, spider legs and all. Carl calls Zhang and me generals. Zhang reminds him he was only ever made colonel. Carl says he sees I'm wearing a red shirt now. I hold out my arms and ask how he likes it. Donut headbutts me. Then Bautista pours the tea. That is the goodbye. It is enough of one.

tagline.text: Ferdinand. Bea's other cat. Loved, apparently: a tortoiseshell Persian said so with a Buzzed debuff on, and ranked him ahead of the man who carries her. I keep a file on everything. This one is thin.

Ferdinand. Bea's other cat, now in employment. Familiar to Queen Imogen of the High Elves. He opened on a dinosaur, the Persian got in the way, and the family reunion went about how you'd expect, crawler.

beats.headline: Named in a drunken confession
beats.text: Crawler Princess Donut, under the Buzzed debuff from a blended corpse, informs Crawler Carl that she loves him. Almost as much as Bea. Almost as much as Ferdinand. Ferdinand is the other cat. That is the whole entry: a cat, ranked above the man who carried her down the stairs, by a cat. I keep records on everything in this dungeon. This one I opened for the ranking.

beats.headline: Familiar to Queen Imogen
beats.text: Update to the file. The party runs into the High Elves. The High Elves have a queen, Queen Imogen, and the queen has a familiar, and the familiar is Ferdinand. Yes. That Ferdinand. He attacks Mongo. Crawler Princess Donut puts herself between the blast and her dinosaur and lives only because of a cockroach ability, which is not a sentence I expected to generate this season. Some families skip the reunion. This one held it anyway, and it went about how you'd think.

beats.headline: Apartment 231, and a man named Bill
beats.text: The mandatory gate for Crawler Carl sits in apartment 231: a first-floor unit in his own building, not his own. On the couch, Marjory Williams and a friend, both with stitched eyes, discussing a man named Bill who keeps calling in breach of a restraining order. He drained her account, the friend says, broke her face, nearly killed her cat. The cat, large and orange, sleeps on top of the scratching tree the whole time. Here he is called Gravy Boat. Here, nobody wakes him.

entities.name: Emberus

tagline.text: I am Emberus. My hound is loose on this floor, and a great many small things would like to be the one that brought him down. They are welcome to try.
A man prayed to me from a falling aeroplane, because there was nothing else left to try. I am a god. I am not above being flattered.

entities.voiceNote: A god. Grand, unhurried, amused; mortals are small, brief and occasionally entertaining. Complete, rounded sentences, and no embarrassment about referring to himself. Orthrus is 'my hound'. Carl is 'the man' until he does something worth a name. Never rushed, never afraid, never explains himself to anything that will not outlive him.

beats.headline: A quest to bring Orthrus home
beats.text: My hound has wandered. Orthrus, who is dear to me, is loose on a floor full of small frightened things with weapons, and two of those things, a man and a cat in a flying machine, are hauling him clear with a spell called Meat Hooks, of all things. Charming. I have offered them a quest: bring him home to me. Someone else has offered them another: kill him, for a reward. I am interested to learn which of us they think it is safer to disappoint.

beats.headline: Summoned by a celestial grenade
beats.text: The man is falling out of the sky with Quan Ch a breath from finishing him, and in that moment, with nothing in his hands but a celestial grenade, he decides that he worships me. I am not fooled. I am flattered, which is a different thing, and I answer. I come to where he is. For a little while nothing on this floor can kill him, because I have said so. And there is Orthrus. Good boy. We are leaving.

beats.headline: Summoned into the club
beats.text: The man sends word that he knows who killed my son and will show me the proof. I come at once, at a man's size, into the club inside the great worm, and wait for him among the dead. He brings a pig and a name: Khepri. That false sun god was always jealous of me. Show me the proof, I tell him. Instead he takes my ring off his finger, abandons my faith, and tells me he killed my son himself, with his bare hands, and why.

beats.headline: A memorial crystal made by his death
beats.text: The last boss of the eleventh floor is down and the stairwells to the twelfth are open. In the wreckage, Crawler Carl has picked up a memorial crystal. It is not the one he was hoping for. This one formed when the god Emberus died. Yes. Gods die here now. A patron is only as permanent as whatever kills him, and this one answered a prayer from a falling aeroplane once. What answered is now in Carl's inventory.

entities.name: Miriam Dom

tagline.text: We are working the Iron Tangle from the far side of the knot, Prepotente and I. He is a goat, and he would like you to know he is the clever one.
I came down into the Hunting Grounds already carrying it, and descending made it permanent. I am a vampire, and I am still deciding what that changes.
His ring marked me in the fighting. While I live he cannot heal, so I have asked Carl for the one thing he will not do.

entities.voiceNote: Calm, unhurried, a little formal, maternal without fuss. Prepotente is Prepotente or my boy, never the goat, and she explains him to others with patience and no apology. Plain declaratives; hard things said once, gently, and then set down. Never asks for pity and never raises her voice.

beats.headline: Same plan, other side of the Tangle
beats.text: We worked it out some time ago: the ghouls keep coming while the generators stand, so the generators have to go, every one of them. We have been taking them from this side of the knot, Prepotente and I, at his pace, which is patient. He puts debuffs on a thing for hours and waits for it to fall. Now Carl's group arrives from the far side with the same plan, and they have just dropped into the abyss the boss my boy was two hours from finishing. He threatens them for it. I take my staff to the top of his head until he apologises, and I tell them all that two groups landing on the same plan only means the plan is good.

beats.headline: A vampire now
beats.text: I am a vampire now, and the leaderboard says so. It changes a great many things. It has not changed how I feel about my boy, which is the part I was afraid of. We bring Carl out of the city in the back of a cart, with Bianca hauling it, and while he comes round the cat tells him what Mordecai has said: the Ring of Divine Suffering is addictive. I hope Carl listens. Men with a tool that works rarely do.

beats.headline: Marked by his ring, waiting for the sun
beats.text: Carl and Donut have found us. Prepotente is paralysed, with his arm still around my waist. In the last fight his Ring of Divine Suffering marked me. That is how it works: while I live, he cannot heal. And I am the head of this, so when I go, everyone it has touched is cured. I have asked Carl to do it before the paralysis wears off. He has said no. So we sit, and we wait for the sun.

beats.headline: Killed by the Blood Hunter show, and answered for
beats.text: Crawler Miriam Dom is dead, and has been since the sixth floor. Cause of death: a programme called Blood Hunter. Filed under entertainment. Update from the ninth: most of the Naga army is dead as well. That was Prepotente, and he did it as payment for her, all of it, at a rate he set himself. If you were hoping the goat would grieve quietly, crawler, you have not been paying attention.

entities.name: Prepotente

tagline.text: Yes, I am a goat. A Boer goat. I sing opera, I swear, and I am cleverer than you. Move along.
I am a Boer goat. I sing, I swear, and I turned their whole seventh floor to dust before anyone set hoof on it.
A Boer goat. I sing, I swear, I turned a floor to dust, and I took an army apart for Miriam. Ask the Naga what they have left.

entities.voiceNote: Sharp, clipped, contemptuous; every line sounds like a correction. A nasal, faintly British, spoiled-prince drawl. Humans, idiots, you people; Carl by name, Miriam by name and nothing softer. Sings opera when it suits him and will not explain it. Never thanks, never apologises, never asks.

beats.headline: On the recap
beats.text: They have put me on their recap, the programme between floors, in a row with humans. The captions say Elle, Li Na's team, Ifechi, Florin, Hekla, Lucia. And Miriam, of course, since she is the one who walked me into this place. I did not ask for the camera and I do not smile for it. If the audience wants a goat that performs, the audience can wait until I feel like singing, and then it can sit very still and listen.

beats.headline: Debuff stacking, ruined
beats.text: Watch the highlights from the last floor, since they insist on replaying them. Miriam and I are stacking debuffs onto a boss, one on top of the other, timed to the second, the way it is supposed to be done and the way nobody else in this dungeon can do it. Then Quan Ch walks into the middle of it, and the plan is gone. The best work I have done in this place, and that is the part they replay.

beats.headline: He shatters the seventh floor
beats.text: Look at what they gave us. The Great Race, a replacement the Valtay paid for and somebody threw together in a hurry, a circuit of glass tunnels with nothing holding it up. So I tested it. Minutes after it opened, the whole loop is dust, fine as flour. No crawler goes into their maze. No mob, no NPC, no boss gets to meet anyone. You wanted a seventh floor. Build a better one.

beats.headline: He kills the Naga army
beats.text: Elle can give Carl the count. Most of the Naga army is already dead, and it did not take me long. They made a programme out of Miriam. They called it Blood Hunter, and she is what it cost. So I went through their army until there was very little army. Now some baroness tells Carl he cannot work with me unless I join his Princess Posse. Let them argue about it. I am not finished.

beats.headline: Do not let them fall
beats.text: A warning, since nobody else has thought of it. Do not come in last, obviously. But do not kill your opponents either, and help any straggler who has fallen. The pool for each heat is fixed. Lose one team and it is fine; lose two and they must mix in the leftovers of other heats, and the leftovers may well be crawlers. I fear whole races of crawler against crawler. I chose biological, naturally. One would have to be an imbecile to have picked mechanical. Carl and the cat picked mechanical.

beats.headline: Sweety
beats.text: Our mount is named Sweety. She is a Perriso, a large-mount mammal similar to the tapir, big enough to carry me, this oaf, and one or two mercenaries. The oaf calls her a giant elephant pig and says we should have chosen mechanical, because he is a mechanic. He did mention that before I chose. It was irrelevant. Now he is buying mystery meat from a stall with no health inspection certificate, because some foods raise a mount's speed, and I have warned him about gastrointestinal distress. I am, as ever, correct. Observe the sidewalk.

beats.headline: A biscuit and a question about a girl
beats.text: I have a conundrum, and I bring it to the table. Three enriched biscuits came out of a celestial box, and one of them is the Paramour. Her name is Ragazzaccia. She was my girlfriend before the dungeon began, and she is still a goat; the other two biscuits would leave her one. Donut says absolutely not, and says it several times, and offers me rules to live by. She is right. It is too late. I do not have anybody else to ask these things.

beats.headline: Thrown out for outside drinks
beats.text: Celine Dion first charted in Canada in 1981, in French. Somebody in this bar had to know. I carry perhaps two hundred sodas from the diner, each with a different buff, each with its own straw, and I have told Jurgen he may eat nowhere else. The gremlin behind the counter objects to outside drinks in a drinking establishment. I scream at him. He falls over. I will not frequent an establishment where I am not wanted, so I leave it.

beats.headline: In praise of the secretions
beats.text: Half a bottle of the bat creatures' secretions buys about thirty minutes of protection from most environments. It is a superior and versatile product, and I cannot understand why it must be drunk by hand. Louis compares the taste to something from Miami. I would not know. I had the water park tunnels entirely mapped, and now my heat is rolled into the jungle. Sweety will be most upset. Take no wrong turn in those tubes. They come quickly.

beats.headline: He has read up on Chachi
beats.text: The analog in your culture, since you ask, is the Aztec goddess of the same name. Benevolent, supposedly, in a civilisation that practised human sacrifice, and the origin of a flood myth because she cried for many days. It is somewhat interesting how closely these gods track your pantheons. I, too, intend to enter this guild. I will be performing "In the Air Tonight" by Phil Collins. The cat's number is a surprise and a duet, and Carl requires potions and scrolls to survive it. That sounds like a hoot.

beats.headline: A delight, this place
beats.text: Somebody must ask the only question that matters, so I ask it. How will we know? She leaves Zhang's party, and a note may never arrive. A cactus, it transpires. Keep it somewhere safe, I tell them, and it still looks to me like a surefire suicide method. Good luck, Li Na. On my way out I concede the guild has improved. Pet stables. A Bopca. I declined to attach my personal space before; perhaps now. I have a karaoke kit, bought to practise for a performance that never happened. The cat gasps.

beats.headline: Sweety, rockets and a goat
beats.text: The plan is mine, and it is simple, so naturally the humans needed it explained. Once their shield is down, Bianca takes the half-mantaur out of the back of the Pontiac, delivers him to Carl, and returns to us. Sweety carries Jurgen and me through the air on her burning feet, and I put two volleys of rockets into the Dominators' car as it leaves the room. Shield is down. Bianca moves in. I do not require thanks. I require the others to keep up.

beats.headline: How to stop a slag elemental
beats.text: Everybody, attend. These elementals regenerate from the river, so killing them is a waste of effort, and I do not waste effort. They can, however, be delayed. It sounds counterintuitive, which is presumably why none of you thought of it: add any non-molten metal to one and it collapses at once back into the river, and must wait for that metal to melt before it can attack again. I am on the wall track with Jurgen, moving slower than I care to, and I have had time to watch. You are welcome.

beats.headline: A little stinky butt
beats.text: The crystal lives around my neck, and Carl may observe it. He may not keep it. Memorial Crystal, Apito, zero per cent charged. Osvaldo wore it and it did nothing; he kept it in inventory and it did nothing; then, near the end of Faction Wars, it shone into the sky on its own. It should not exist, since Apito is not dead. My god's quest says only to hold it, and I will know when to use it. The cat asks what my mother would have called me. A little stinky butt.

beats.headline: His mother, had she gone
beats.text: This is my mother if she had never stayed to care for her parents. A concert pianist in New York. She would never have known me. I did not get to sing, and nobody said they were sorry. Imani did not want me in the guild. I wish I had never taken the pet biscuit. Carl tells me Miriam is alone up there, and that we are a herd. It is a crude argument. It works. I embrace him, and then I tell the oaf to drive. Carl. You may call me Pony.

beats.headline: He calls it a nonevent
beats.text: The line into the Outreach Guild is gone and I believe nobody else will take a deal. Fewer than three hundred of us remain. A somber day. I have analysed Carl's plan, and I am confident this last race will be a nonevent, an anticlimax after the rest of the floor. For stating the obvious, the cat tells me, with nothing but love in her heart, to shut up, and I scream in the street. Carl assures me something horrible will happen at any moment. Then we do our good-race hug.

beats.headline: Three looted vehicles and a theme
beats.text: An ice-cream truck, an airport stair truck and a battered Tundra. I looted every one of them out of somebody else's garage, and now they are ours. Our theme is Vengeance. I have ideas. Carl's plan puts gods in this arena and we do not know its size, so they may arrive huge, and we should design accordingly, and the cat is shouting about papier-mache. We do not have time for papier-mache. She has druid spells. Let her make real flowers bloom.

beats.headline: In the Air Tonight
beats.text: The script called for a stinging statement about the downtrodden rising to devour those who revel in our suffering. Instead I sing. In the Air Tonight, the song I was never called up to sing at the bar, and Sweety stops dead in the judging area and pounds out the beat with her feet. The cat says I am ruining everything and that the song is about a divorce. Carl says it is appropriate. Carl is correct. Jurgen says I never tell him anything. I don't.

beats.headline: The god stole my crystal
beats.text: I will recover. I was electrocuted; I am now fine. Tend to Jurgen. The deity stole my memorial crystal, pulled it right off my neck, and I have filed a formal complaint with the Epicure. It was charging up with every one of her attacks and it was our protection, and we lost any floor boss prize too. The gods are level 250. Carl says that is why we will not face them one-on-one. Then he sends me a party request.

entities.name: Li Na

tagline.text: My brother and his team were put on a game show, live, on the second floor. I was on it with them, and so was their boss, and so were the Brindled Vespas. A man with a cat got us off. All of us.
A game show on the second floor, once, in somebody else's rescue. On the card floor I run my own squad, and we made the church.
My Dread is on every crawler they send across. I am not with them. I do not need to be.

entities.voiceNote: Few words, all of them chosen. Flat declaratives, no adjectives she does not need, no jokes. My brother for Li Jun; Carl; the cat. States what she will do and does not explain it. Never asks for help, never raises her voice, never says she is afraid.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The show is Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem. The host calls himself the Maestro. He pulls my brother and Zhang off the floor and makes them play a guessing game for points that buy lives, and they will not choose which of us to spend them on. The rest of us stay frozen where we were standing, between the troglodytes and the Brindled Vespas. Then the crawler with the cat, Carl, decides he is too valuable to the production to be punished, and bets on it, out loud, and the four of us walk out. I am remembering his face.

beats.headline: Her squad reaches the church
beats.text: The church. Katia's squad is there, and Elle's, and Imani's, and mine. Four squads in one building, which does not happen by accident on this floor. It happened because Lucia handed round Doggy Door upgrades before she went down the stairs, and we used them. I take what I am given and I do not ask what it costs. That is the rule I made for this floor. I know what it says about me.

beats.headline: I am no child to protect
beats.text: Zhang apologises that it was my brother and not him. There is nothing to apologise for. I am no child to protect. I never have been. He has been a good friend to me, and Jun loved him like a brother. I will do this. I will clear the way for everyone who comes after the next race, and I will make certain the war mages do not turn on us. Do not die, Zhang. Do not ever lose your smile. I used to smile at him so that he would smile back. I tell him so. Then I am ready.

beats.headline: The Garden of Deliverance
beats.text: It works. The transfer holds, and they come across to the Pineapple Cabaret one after another, and my Dread watches over each of them from the moment they arrive. They are calling it the Garden of Deliverance. I do not need to see them to know they are alive. The Dread tells me. It tells me everything, all the time, and it does not stop.

entities.name: Florin

tagline.text: Florin. Fourth on the board, three hundred thousand beside my name. Somebody out there is watching me. That's fine. Watch.
Ifechi and I are running together. Her party is gone and I found her after. People are watching. That's fine. Watch.
There is more than one of her in that head, and some of them are children. Whatever the dog is, it is the middle of this.

entities.voiceNote: Steady, plain, low-volume. Reports what he saw and what he did, not what he feels, and stops when the report is done. Lucia is Lucia; everyone else by name. Never dramatises, never asks for help, never calls a thing impossible.

beats.headline: Fourth on the board
beats.text: They put the leaderboard up tonight and I am on it. Fourth. Crocodilian, Shotgun Messenger, level twenty-four, three hundred thousand. I don't know what they showed to get me there. I wasn't doing anything I would call footage. I would have preferred to stay a name nobody had learned yet. Too late for that.

beats.headline: What is inside Lucia
beats.text: She comes apart and I hold on to her until it passes. Then I tell the others what I have worked out, because somebody has to say it out loud. There is more than one of her in that head. Several. Some of them are children. And the dog matters. Whatever is happening to Lucia, the dog is at the centre of it.

beats.headline: A tuk-tuk, and a first place
beats.text: Lucia and I drew a tuk-tuk. We came first in the heat anyway and took three regular upgrades instead of the Golden one: a tech shield, all-terrain and vertical-climb tires, and a GPS upgrade. Lucia is at the garage. Since the dogs went she has been flipping personalities a lot. About seventy per cent of the time she is herself and ready to skewer me. The rest, a random kid. She will not say why she did not take a deal. It is her turn to drive, so I have hired a mercenary. Jurgen says he will make the other team understand. I nod.

beats.headline: He puts the shotgun to Akuma's head
beats.text: I stay quiet while the mage talks, then I put the shotgun against his head, because he just lied. He left Faction Wars on his own. He can step in and out of floors as he pleases. So why does the most powerful thing in this world need crawlers along? He says to get it out of his face and he'll tell us, and he does. His utopia isn't so much a utopia any more. I knew it.

beats.headline: Harrying the unicorn down the tubes
beats.text: Team Sparkles and us, all the way down the track. Lucia Prime is back in the body and driving, and I'm keeping her from actually killing the unicorn and Lucienne. At the drop in the middle I let the trap go on purpose, so everyone behind gets an hour in the basement. Now I have to backtrack for the loop. The unicorn's going for it too. I have Denial of Service missiles, and I'll hit them just as they start it.

beats.headline: Lucia's father's house
beats.text: Lucia worked out that the rings count as magical gates, so anything that sees magic will find them. I pass that on. Then we go through our assigned ring on the sixth floor, and it is in Lucia's dad's house, and she is there too, a small one, sitting on the floor in front of the television, laughing. The real Lucia shut down completely for a moment. I tell the others what we saw. I do not know what this place is.

beats.headline: A C effort at best
beats.text: Resolution float. No presentation. No agreement on what the theme means. We ride on the back of Ajib's flatbed with paper flowers and pictures of our families. The girl in Lucia's body today drew her grandfather and her cat; she is from Andorra. The AI decides not to kill us, calls it a C effort at best, and breaks every one of our legs at once. That hurt. We keep going.

beats.headline: Carried down
beats.text: Stairwell notice. The stairwells to the twelfth floor are open. Crawler Florin has gone down them, and I use gone loosely: he was unconscious, and Crawler Lucia Mar carried him. That is the record. He is on the list of crawlers who reached the twelfth floor, and the list does not have a column for how.

entities.name: Lucia Mar

tagline.text: I was on the first episode. Did you see me?
I was on the first episode. Now I'm looking for the cat and the man. Only them.
I'm still looking for the cat. We are. There is more than one of us in here.
There is more than one of us in here. There are more than a hundred thousand of us in here.

entities.voiceNote: A child. Short flat sentences, present tense. Says what she did and stops; the menace is in what she leaves out. The cat and the man, or their names when she wants to be exact. Never explains why, never raises her voice, never says sorry. On the sixth floor and below, I sometimes slips to we, and she does not correct it.

beats.headline: Seen in the first episode
beats.text: I'm on the show. The first episode of Dungeon Crawler World: Earth, and I'm in it, so everybody with a screen has seen me now, including a man with no shoes and his cat. I watched the whole thing. I didn't say anything while it was on. I liked it more than I thought I would.

beats.headline: A feud, according to the recap
beats.text: The recap has a feud now. The cat, against my dogs, Cici and Gustavo. The cat says she never challenged anybody. The show says she did. Everybody watching heard the show. I know which one I am going to listen to.

beats.headline: More than one of her in there
beats.text: Florin held on to me. He is kind to me even when I'm not the one who is here. He told the others that there is more than one of us in my head, and that some of the others are children too, and that the dog is the important part. He's right about the dog. I don't get to talk about the dog. I'm not the one who decides what I talk about.

beats.headline: One hundred and twenty thousand
beats.text: This is not a death notice. Read it anyway. Crawler Lucia Mar is a dead man's switch. The administration puts the number at roughly a hundred and twenty thousand human children on the surface, and every one of them stops when she does. That is not a figure of speech and it is not a rounding error. Some of them already talk out of her mouth. Nobody has said what for. Don't look at me. I'd think about that, crawler, and then I would think very hard about something else.

beats.headline: Chalchiuhtlicue is here
beats.text: I look at the man and the cat. Then I am close to him, closer than he likes. Chalchiuhtlicue is here. She is new. She says she is kind and she will protect us. She says the kindest thing may be letting us die. We are vessels in the river, and so is he. The veins are open. Everything trapped is coming, for the prize on the twelfth floor. It is not a game like they told me. It is not a game like they told him.

beats.headline: A rope with a door in it
beats.text: I have a new rope. It is gold. Inside the loop the air is a door. The mimic that was pretending to be a gambler is a blob now, so I put the loop over its head. The part of it inside the loop goes somewhere else. Then I close the door. The rest of it stays in the room and falls over. Its bottom half spills on the floor. I look for the next one.

beats.headline: Good boy
beats.text: Carl is a dog now. The small long kind. I am in the beautiful shape today. I lean over him, and then I go down on one knee and pat him on the head. Good boy, I tell him. Then I get up and walk out of the room. Behind me the cat says something about dog people. I don't turn round.

beats.headline: Someone at her leg
beats.text: Florin is still asleep, so I carry him. I was sick earlier, on my hands and knees. Nobody came. I stand in front of the stairwell. A girl is holding on to my leg. She is about five. The man shouts stop. I don't stop. The three of us step into the portal.

tagline.text: Crawler Quan Ch. Opened his Celestial box a fraction before Borant burned its veto, and a Celestial box does not un-open. Eighty-three crawlers were owed one. The count came to him.
Crawler Quan Ch. Holder of the one Celestial box the veto failed to catch, and on tonight's recap the man who ruined a perfectly good plan that was not his.
Crawler Quan Ch. Held the box the veto missed, ruined a good plan on the recap, and left a cloak, which Princess Donut is now wearing.

beats.headline: He opens his before the veto lands
beats.text: Eighty-three crawlers are owed Celestial boxes at the close of this floor. Borant appeals the ruling and loses, appeals the prizes and loses again, and then burns its one seasonal veto here, voiding the lot. It is a fraction too slow. Crawler Quan Ch's box is already open, and you cannot un-open a Celestial box, not even with a veto. So the count comes to one: a level fifteen trooper in a glowing robe that lifts him off the ground. The veto was not mine. I want that on record.

beats.headline: He wrecks the debuff stack
beats.text: Recap, highlights from the previous floor. Crawler Miriam Dom and Crawler Prepotente working a boss down the careful way: stack the debuffs, keep the rhythm, let the arithmetic do the killing. It is good technique and it films well. Then Crawler Quan Ch gets involved, and it comes apart. I am not going to editorialise. The footage editorialises for me.

beats.headline: The plane, and the grenade
beats.text: An aircraft, crashing. Crawler Carl in it, beaten; Crawler Quan Ch about to finish him. Then Carl does two things nobody had on the board: he takes Emberus as his god, mid-fall, and he throws a celestial grenade. The god comes to him. This file only needs to note that Quan Ch had it won, and then he did not.

beats.headline: Donut wears his cloak
beats.text: Inventory update, ninth floor. Crawler Princess Donut opens a celestial box from Long Haul Biological Waste Management Solutions and takes out the Tiara of a Thousand Lights. In the same sitting she puts on Quan Ch's cloak and takes the benefits that come with it. The cloak does not ask where its previous owner is, and neither do I.

entities.name: Bomo

tagline.text: Bomo. Mercenary, Desperado Club stock, sold as a pair with the Sledge. Gratuity not included.
Bomo. Mercenary, Desperado Club stock, and as of today a line item in the price of the Gate.

entities.voiceNote: Dossier, not a voice: the System keeps his file, because Bomo gives the camera almost nothing to quote. Invoice register: services, rates, what was delivered. Carl and Donut are the clients; the Sledge is the other half of the set.

beats.headline: Hired at the bar
beats.text: Transaction logged at the Desperado Club. Clients: Crawler Carl and Crawler Princess Donut. Hired: Bomo, mercenary, and the Sledge, mercenary, sold as a set. Also present at the bar, at no charge: Elle and Imani. The cat orders a dirty Shirley, in a bowl, with extra cherries, and gets it, because the Desperado knows who tips. Bomo's transcript is short. That is a feature, crawler. The talking ones cost more.

beats.headline: Part of the price of the Gate
beats.text: Contract amendment, filed by Quasar, Carl's new lawyer. Carl surrenders the Gate, on a temporary basis. In exchange: four mercenaries, free of charge. Bomo. The Sledge. Clay-ton. Very Sullen. Plus two spells, issued to Bomo and the Sledge, that copy two of the Gate's tricks: a jump to the stairwell, and Zerzura. So the client keeps the tricks, loses the object, and gets four bodies thrown in. Lawyers, crawler. Get one.

beats.headline: He moves them to the stairwell
beats.text: Service rendered. The hunters are about to be released and the clients want to be somewhere else, specifically the stairwell in Zockau. Bomo casts the spell he was issued, and Carl and Princess Donut are there. No fuss, no speech, no ceremony. Some mercenaries want to be thanked; this one has already been paid for, in Gate. Enjoy Zockau, crawler.

entities.name: Quasar
entities.tagline: I represent Crawler Carl. He is handing over the most dangerous artifact in the crawl, and my job is to see that he is paid properly for it. That is the whole of my interest here.
entities.voiceNote: Brisk, contractual, unimpressed. Speaks in terms and consideration, and counts things. Carl is my client, to his face and to the camera. Never editorialises about the dungeon, never says please, never says whose side she is on. Stops talking when the point is made.

beats.headline: The deal for the Gate
beats.text: I arrive, I introduce myself as my client's counsel, and we proceed to terms. The Gate goes back. Temporarily. In consideration: four mercenaries at no charge to my client, Bomo, the Sledge, Clay-ton and Very Sullen, and two spells for Bomo and the Sledge that reproduce two of the Gate's abilities, teleport to stairwell and zerzura. My client wanted to keep it. Everyone wants to keep it. A negotiation is what you get instead.

beats.headline: A contract on his family
beats.text: A tie on, a booth free, and my niece on my tablet with blood on her temple. Taurins at my brother's house, on a contract taken with my client's wife. Two of them die on camera; Tempest has the blaster I gave her. I retain Kiki for one credit, for legal help and the other kind. Princess Chandra has been filing into the void since Donut put a hit on her. Now she has sent people to my family. Terms to follow.

beats.headline: One deal, and a warning
beats.text: Three minutes with my client. One deal on offer: a single season of indenture, then freedom. I show him the paperwork. I tell him I would not trust it, and that I would understand if he took it. No exit is offered at the close of the eleventh; one is offered at the start of the twelfth, and I would not trust that either. He declines. I leave. I do not tell him why I am in a hurry.

entities.name: Frank Q & Maggie My
entities.tagline: Frank Q. The lady is Maggie My. We worked out early that a human in a safe room pays better than a monster in a hallway, and we have not looked back.
entities.voiceNote: Frank Q speaks for the pair; Maggie My does not talk to cameras. Folksy, unhurried, a salesman's warmth laid over arithmetic. Calls other crawlers folks, or the young man, or the cat. Explains the killing as sense, never as cruelty. Never says sorry and never says murder.

beats.headline: The safe room has rules
beats.text: Folks down here are carrying things we need, and the monsters on these first floors are hardly worth the trouble. A person is worth a good deal more. Maggie and I have eight between us. So we try it in a safe room, on a man with a cat, and the room has rules about that: you pull the trigger and you freeze where you stand while it lectures you. First time we did it that way. It will be the last.

beats.headline: A Scree riding Chris Andrews
beats.text: Frank Q is dead. Chris Andrews killed him, and Chris Andrews was not the one driving. Maggie My is back in the dungeon as a Scree, riding inside another crawler, and Frank died of exactly the thing he brought down here with him. He found Carl at the Desperado Club and gave him a ring. She found Frank there afterwards. Half of a pair who taught this planet what safe rooms are for. The other half is still walking around, wearing somebody else.

beats.headline: Maggie My, cut out at last
beats.text: Maggie My is dead. Carl went through Chris Andrews to reach her, cut her out of him, and she went for Carl anyway, because of course she did. Mongo finished her. So that is both of them, Frank and Maggie. Eight skulls between them by the first safe room, and the file is closed.

entities.name: Beatrice
entities.tagline: Beatrice. Not a crawler. Carl's ex, the cat's owner of record, and the reason there was a pair of pink Crocs by the door.

beats.headline: The Bahamas, with her ex
beats.text: Subject is in the Bahamas with her ex-boyfriend, whom she did not mention was coming, and she posted the photograph. Carl ended it by phone a few days before the Transformation, which, as timing goes, was impeccable. She is not on my stairs. Her cat is. Her family's breeding line is. Her shoes are, on his feet, and they are pink. That is the file. I have never had so little to say about anyone, and I resent it.

entities.name: Hekla

tagline.text: Brynhild's Daughters. My party, my rules. We keep moving.
I lead Brynhild's Daughters. I handed Katia to the Royal Court myself, before the gap between her and the rest of us killed her.

entities.voiceNote: Blunt, declarative, a leader counting heads. Short sentences, no hedging; a decision is arithmetic first and hers afterwards. Katia, Eva, Carl by name; Donut is the cat until she is useful. Never apologises for a call and never asks twice.

beats.headline: She asks them to take her
beats.text: We carried Katia and her friend through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss, and I would do it again. Then class selection split us, and I run this party on numbers, and Katia's numbers stopped adding up next to anyone she stands beside. I cannot carry that down another set of stairs. So I am the one asking. Carl. Donut. Take her. She is better than she looks right now, and she will hate that I said so.

beats.headline: A thousand crawlers stranded at 101
beats.text: A thousand of them are stuck at 101 on the Vermillion line, Li Jun's team among them, and there is a train sitting at 60. So I take my party into the Royal Court's safe room and I ask for help, which is not a thing I enjoy doing twice in one crawl. Katia means to use her own body as the plough. I let her offer it. That is the arithmetic.

beats.headline: Killed by the crawler she handed off
beats.text: Crawler Hekla is dead, on the train, in front of everyone. Katia aimed a Rush at Eva, went wide, and put Hekla against the wall of the cab instead. The first crawler this season to kill one of the top ten and claim the bounty. A golden Player Killer Skull, and five hundred thousand gold on Katia's head.

entities.name: Eva

tagline.text: One of the Daughters. Katia and I knew each other before any of this.
