beats.text: Subject crawled in the fifteenth season, chose the High Elf race and a rogue’s class, and wrote the second edition of the book that keeps being handed down. He now goes by Dr. Hu, and he is spending a small NFC's money, more of it than anyone should ask about, on the crawler who holds his book. He is therefore both an advertisement for the dungeon and a witness against it, and production has never worked out how to bill him.

entities.name: Jamal
entities.tagline: A hammerhead shark that breathes air, and spent his first years as ink on somebody’s shoulder.

beats.headline: The shark has a name
beats.text: Subject existed first as a magical tattoo carried on Tsarina Signet’s skin, one that could fly, and is now a seventeen-foot hammerhead shark that breathes air and flops where he once flew. He rolls with Carl’s squad now, answers to Jamal, speaks of himself as Jamal, and keeps telling the legs Carl builds him to hop, which breaks them.

beats.headline: Stuck on the ceiling, afraid of heights
beats.text: Found at the pit stop: Jamal, attached to the roof of the garage, where he has been since many hours before the race began, testing whether his new sticky feet could walk upside down. They could. He cannot get down. Jamal is afraid of heights. He explains that Hedy told him if Carl dies, everyone in the garage simply stops, and that he climbed up to see everything at once, the way the old Jamal did, and now he is scared of what he might lose.

beats.headline: The shark loses his legs
beats.text: Jamal crosses the arena with his flamethrower roaring and Samantha on his head, landing on monsters and snapping them in half. His Tundra sits in a smoking wreck against the wall. When the god goes up, the blast throws him against the far wall and wrecks his legs until they fall off him. He is alive.

entities.name: Drick
entities.tagline: Old, scarred, still heavily muscled, and no longer entirely the one driving.

beats.headline: Crawling Through the Ages
beats.text: Subject is a former crawler and a member of the Dream, appearing on a CrawlCon panel on the current state of the crawl. He is also carrying a Gondii worm in his brain on behalf of the Valtay, which is a detail the panel does not cover. He brags well. It is the part of him that is still his own.

entities.name: Anton
entities.tagline: Bald, muscular, crossbow, black cape, and prison tattoos that predate the dungeon.

beats.headline: Hostile on arrival, and reasonable about it
beats.text: Subject took the Fugitive Class and wears a leather jacket, knee-high boots and a black cape. He carries a crossbow. He is covered in tattoos he did not acquire down here. He and his party meet the court while hostile, having heard what a certain cat said about Cat Girls, and the misunderstanding is cleared up faster than anybody expected.

entities.name: Gluteus Maxx
entities.tagline: A dancer from the club’s ground floor, hired as muscle, and better at it than the hiring implied.

beats.headline: Short, fuzzy, and available
beats.text: Subject dances at the Penis Parade and, since the court took on the club’s people, fights for it: short, hairy, built like the job, and insistent on twin war gauntlets. Crawler Katia’s review, on file: a bit of a jerk, a good dancer, and a little in love with the cat.

beats.headline: Two uppers, and the wheel
beats.text: Chosen to drive heat three because Crawler Carl cannot reach the pedals in a kangaroo and Gluteus Maxx is the best of the strippers at Mario Kart. He drives in a Speedo and a borrowed hockey helmet. At the line his eyes are red. Samantha found outworlder uppers in the garbage pile from the snake guy and says one before a race lets you taste time; it is how she wins at Mario Kart. He took two. It is too late to change drivers.

entities.name: Geraldo
entities.tagline: An aquatic melee tank who was not wearing the headband before he was captured, and has not taken it off since.

beats.headline: He joins the squad
beats.text: Subject is a Monk Seal Picket Sentry, an aquatic mob built to stand in front of things. He was taken rather than recruited. Summoned, he wears a white headband with red hearts on it matching the team flag, which he did not own when he was captured, and he flips through the air shouting his own kung-fu sound effects. That part came with the species.

entities.name: Harbinger
entities.tagline: A liaison who disagrees with his own side’s philosophy and is working, openly enough, to take two crawlers off the board.

beats.headline: He says so to their faces
beats.text: Subject is a caprid liaison, sent to sit in wherever a crawler might be alone with a sponsor. At the end of the first interview he sits in on, he tells Carl to his face that Carl needs to be removed from the crawl, and that he is actively working to have both Carl and Prepotente disposed of. I record this as a courtesy on his part. Most of the people trying that do not announce it.

beats.headline: He exerts himself
beats.text: Harbinger, liaison, expelled from the herd, teleports into the Plenty's studio carrying an enormous pulse rifle and addresses the matriarch as Mother. He warned her. She did not listen. He has been alone in this, and he is lonely. Exertion, he reminds her, is meant to be an expression of joy. He will exert himself now: protect the herd, protect the universe, and do what should have been done from the start. He raises the rifle at Crawler Carl. The AI intervenes. Everything inside the goat is suddenly outside the goat.

tagline.text: A name out of an old debt, and a price somebody declined to pay.
A Grixist heiress, chief executive of Icon Industries, and a god to drive whenever she is bored.

beats.headline: Sponsor to a goddess
beats.text: Subject is of the Grixist Swarm, an heiress and chief executive of Icon Industries, and at present the sponsor driving the goddess Eileithyia. She sponsored Dodola every season before this one. The sums involved are a day’s allowance to her. She does not do it for the money. She does it because she is bored.

entities.name: Uzi Jesus
entities.tagline: “I am the way, motherfucker.” Level one hundred and forty, undead, origin Ecuador, seventy-five seconds at a time.

beats.headline: A totem with a catchphrase
beats.text: Subject is a unique totem card, held by the court, summoned for seventy-five seconds at a stretch. Level one hundred and forty, constitution two hundred, undead, origin Ecuador. The catchphrase is his own and the card prints it. I did not write that card and I decline responsibility for it.

beats.headline: A toy on the goddess's shoulder
beats.text: Sighting, Hungry Eyes Village: a small robot of Uzi Jesus, action-figure size, climbing out of a food vendor's storage bin with a meat skewer in his mouth and riding on Eris's shoulder. His halo is on a wire. His Uzi is a toy, or is hoped to be. He wants to go and kill Florin, who gave him up. Eris calls him her little pet and has him flip the coin. Eris tells him they need Florin alive, for now.

beats.headline: A toy gun at the heap
beats.text: Uzi Jesus appears on the arena dirt beside Crawler Carl, still tiny, mouth an O, apparently unaware that Eris could take this form. He fires his toy gun at the Scolopendra heap, pop-pop-pop, and reports that there are a lot of people's auras inside. He pokes the frozen Donut with the same gun. Then he climbs a snake tail onto Eris's shoulder, and leaves with her.

tagline.text: One of the club’s people, with a coupon worth a hundred thousand gold.
A level ninety Skin Skellie who took the announcer’s booth rather than the stage, and does both jobs better than the club deserves.

beats.headline: The announcer, not the act
beats.text: Subject is a skeletal Bard, level ninety, working as announcer and disc jockey for one of the club’s establishments rather than performing in it. He also takes mercenary contracts. The two careers turn out to require the same skill, which is holding a room’s attention while something else happens in it.

entities.name: Bodi
entities.tagline: A veteran of Land War, a different game on a different planet, and a battalion commander on the strength of it.

beats.headline: Commander of the 103rd
beats.text: Subject is a veteran of Land War, a different game entirely, which was inflicted on his home planet; everyone calls him a crawler anyway, and he comes to the Princess Posse’s aid during the faction fighting. He is given a battalion, the 103rd, on the strength of what he has done both inside a dungeon and outside one. He has said perhaps three words since.

entities.name: Rend
entities.tagline: A Tummy Acher handed over as a door prize for turning up to a convention, and now levelling in a war.

beats.headline: A gift for attending
beats.text: Subject is a Tummy Acher, a pet-class mob built to absorb damage. He came to Tserendolgor as a gift for attending CrawlCon, and to Carl when she was gone, reset to level one with no name and no memory; the one he answers to now is Louis's work. Tserendolgor took delivery of a party favour. What the group has now is a tank that levels every time it goes hunting, which is not what a party favour is for.

beats.headline: Killed by a look
beats.text: Subject shoulders past Jamal into the safe room behind a drunk Mongo, giggling, at the moment Mordecai walks in with an armful of empty potion balls. Mordecai stops in the middle of his sentence, drops the lot, rises into the air, turns to Rend, and speaks in a voice that is deep and ominous and not his usual one: "And now you perish once again. The next time will herald the beginning of the end." Rend drops dead where he stands. Your pet has died.

beats.headline: A sixth death, and potatoes
beats.text: Subject rises from the dead on the safe room floor, giggling. It is his sixth death, so he keeps his memories and identity, and he comes back a quarter stronger, bigger, and with a new random weakness added to the list under Reaper Gaze: potatoes. Crawler Carl disputes that it was random. The rest is housekeeping. He cannot stay in the safe room, he cannot be let into the garage, and so he goes back into his carrier until there is something to fight.

beats.headline: Eat the rich
beats.text: After the arena. Rend sits against Crawler Carl's side licking a bloody horribles mask. Before the fight he did not want to leave Carl, and went to the RV only when Donut called. In the fight he rode the head of a spiked turtle while Mongo pulled its leg out of the shell. Carl says eat the rich. Rend looks up with his tongue out, and says, for the record, yum.

entities.name: Epitome Tagg
entities.tagline: Son of Epitome Noflex, leader of the Dream, and dressed like any other elf in the room.

beats.headline: Nothing like the reputation
beats.text: Subject leads the Dream and is the son of Epitome Noflex. At the first meeting he wears a plain leather jerkin and is indistinguishable from the dream elves slaughtered on the floor before, which Carl notes at the time. The reputation that precedes him describes an unhinged psychopath. The man in the jerkin does not perform it, and I would not read that as reassurance.

entities.name: Radoslav
entities.tagline: A level seventy-five Bugbear who does a little of everything, racing a vehicle he is fond of for a team that named itself.

beats.headline: Team Free Love, in the heats
beats.text: Subject is a Bugbear Jack of All Trades, level seventy-five, and a self-aware NPC racer in the vehicular heats. He and his one surviving teammate dress for the part, and crash out at the first obstacle of the first race. They are aware of what they are, which the format did not intend and cannot now undo.

beats.headline: The cooler that never empties
beats.text: Subject has survived his first heat and is found in a lawn chair in the Team Roundabout, handing out Busch Light. The van came with a magical cooler that refills itself and teleports back into the van for each race; it is, in his assessment, the only good thing about the van. It always holds three peach-flavored cans that nobody wants, including Crawler Carl and a Razor Fox who works through several of the others. His partner sleeps beside him with his feet in a kiddie pool. Subject's review of the day: a madhouse.

beats.headline: The last can in the cooler
beats.text: Team Free Love has been eliminated due to the death of both racers. Radoslav, bugbear, self-aware NPC racer, sits in that total. The instrument was a can of peach-flavoured beer, drilled out and refilled by Crawler Carl in his bomber's studio and slipped into the team's own magical cooler, which teleported itself back to their van after every race, exactly as advertised. The can was the peach one Radoslav had handed him on the first day.

entities.name: Lucienne
entities.tagline: A Mandagot Fink, level eighty-one, one of two, and rude in a way that reads as policy rather than temper.

beats.headline: Passing on the track, and unpleasant about it
beats.text: Subject is a Mandagot, a Fairy-class creature, level eighty-one, and one of the two members of Team Sparkles. She worships Diwata, which the System flags as an automatic hostility toward anyone Diwata dislikes. She passes the court on the track and is very rude about it. That part is hers, not the goddess’s.

beats.headline: Pulled in by the vermin spell
beats.text: Crawler Princess Donut's Summon Ye, Vermin draws every rodent in the area to her. Lucienne, driver for team Sparkles, qualifies. She arrives on the hood of the court's truck, charmed, choking on the park's air, beating her helmeted head on the windshield to get in. The finish line does not allow passage outside one's conveyance. The barrier pushes her through the glass, and through Crawler Carl, and she comes apart. That is the end of Lucienne.

entities.name: Genesis
entities.tagline: Black hair, a Kentucky accent by Carl’s reckoning, and the half of the pair that does the talking.

beats.headline: One of two womantaur dominators
beats.text: Subject is a Lady Mantaur Dominator, level ninety-five, and one of a pair driving for the Lady Dominators in the heats. She has black hair and a thick American accent that Carl places somewhere around Kentucky. Between the two of them she is the one who does the talking.

beats.headline: She hooks the engineer instead
beats.text: The arrangement was that the womantaurs fetch Crawler Carl a dead joey out of the boss's pouch with their arm chains. Genesis fires into the pouch and puts the grappling hook through the face of Niels, the upgrade engineer the boss had been keeping in there, killing him outright, and drops the body at Carl's feet. Asked why, she says she was not about to let him have the engineer. Neither engineer in the heat is claimed. Her partner adds that a temporary alliance does not make them stupid.

beats.headline: They heard you coming
beats.text: For the record: the Lady Dominators were in their garage, and they were listening. As Crawler Carl's party prepared to cast a hole through the door, the door opened and the GTO rolled out for the starting line, Genesis driving on new tyres that appear to be made of gold, Corky unconscious in the back. A vehicle on its way to the start may not be attacked. Genesis invited Porky to hop in. Corky, she stated, is nontransferable. The party stepped off the driveway.

beats.headline: Eliminated, with the gimp
beats.text: Heat Five results, final line: Eliminated, Lady Dominators and the Gimp. Genesis drove the GTO into the Gasworks factory on golden tyres and did not drive it out. The car went through a trapped floor, the containment failed, and the dolls were at it when Crawler Carl's party took Corky and left. The team is struck from the standings. The gimp, for the record, was no longer theirs by the finish, and would not have agreed that he ever was.

entities.name: Rapture
entities.tagline: Freckled, red-haired, chewing tobacco, and content to let her partner do the talking.

beats.headline: The other womantaur dominator
beats.text: Subject is a Lady Mantaur Dominator, level ninety-five, driving alongside her partner for the Lady Dominators. She has freckled skin and curly red hair and she chews tobacco. She says considerably less than her partner does, which in that vehicle is a structural necessity rather than a personality.

beats.headline: A matched set
beats.text: Rapture, beside the driver, supplied the terms. They had heard about the fleshmancer at the bar. They asked after the crusty old stripper. Corky belongs to them, and they would unzip him and let him spill before handing him over. She patted the door with her lower arm and offered to take Porky too, since they would love a matched set. Then: "See you in the factory." A factory that was not there a moment ago now stands at the end of a new road across the cul-de-sac.

beats.headline: Through the floor
beats.text: The GTO, shield down and hit by Prepotente's hobble missile, went through a trapped floor in the doll-packing room and landed on its side ten metres below: front smashed, a golden wheel sheared off, the axle broken in half. That vehicle is done. Rapture and Genesis are alive, groaning, strung out, and quite possibly without containment, which in this heat means cooking. Cocaine-infused action figures are taking the car apart around them. Crawler Carl's party removed Corky and drove on.

beats.headline: The factory keeps her
beats.text: NPC Rapture, womantaur, dominator and co-owner of a gimp she declined to transfer, is eliminated with her team at the close of Heat Five. Her last recorded position was the bottom of a hole in the doll-packing room, beside Genesis, strung out, containment gone, in a building hot enough to boil anyone uncontained, surrounded by action figures. She told Crawler Carl she would see him in the factory. She was right about that much.

entities.name: Linus
entities.tagline: A tourist who has attached himself to a crawler he says he admires, and the System files him as exactly that.

beats.headline: Filed as: tourist
beats.text: Subject presents as a tourist and a devoted follower of one of the crawlers, to a degree that the crawler in question finds difficult. The System’s notice on him reads, in full, "Linus. Tourist." I have checked it twice. That is the entire entry, and entries that short are usually short for a reason.

beats.headline: The tourist is his brother
beats.text: Linus is dead. Syndicate security killed him in his own trash-filled berth in orbit over Teelan-3, surrounded by posters of the fairy crawler he followed. His brother Minus, a soother, is given five hundred hours of footage, his brother's posts and a ship bought with his brother's money, and sent down as Linus before the tenth floor opens: half-corporeal, a non-combatant, attached to the fairy crawler. He has a primary and a secondary target. He is told to act the pervert for a while.

beats.headline: Unmasked at the farewell
beats.text: Correction to the file. The subject is not Linus. The real Linus died before this floor began, and the soother at the farewell in the square is his brother, brought in afterwards. His targets: Crawler Imani first and Crawler Louis second. Not Carl, whom his superiors want alive, and not the cat, whose death they judged would make Carl too volatile. The poison in the tea would not have worked; the healers had already made everyone immune. He was outed days ago. He was the last in the galaxy to know.

entities.name: Jacobus
entities.tagline: A totem card left switched on by accident, and now somebody’s pet.

beats.headline: The card that never went away
beats.text: Subject is a Reverse Tooth Fairy, level ninety, and he was a totem card until a patch on the Scavenger’s Daughter made him permanent, which nobody intended. He is tiny, absurdly muscled, blond, and his wings move too fast to see. Imani has him now. The paperwork to reverse it does not exist.
